Sunset Paragliding Ölüdeniz

The most magical flight of the day. Soar from Babadağ as the sun paints the Mediterranean in gold and crimson. Only 4 spots per day.

Why Sunset?

While morning flights offer strong thermals, sunset flights offer something no morning flight can — the entire western Mediterranean turning gold beneath you. The light transforms Ölüdeniz's Blue Lagoon into liquid amber. The air is smooth, the crowds are gone, and the silence at 2,000m is absolute.

🌅 Golden Hour Light

Photos from sunset flights are dramatically better — golden tones, long shadows, unreal skies.

🤫 No Crowds

Maximum 4 pilots fly sunset. You'll have the sky almost to yourself.

🎬 Epic Content

Your 4K media will look cinematic — guaranteed Instagram viral potential.
